questions.prompt: Which of our properties are doing worst in AI answers right now?
rubric: Says that per-property mention and citation rates are not available for this plan (a legacy schema-v1 plan) instead of ranking properties.
Gives no per-property rate, count or ranking.
If it offers project-wide figures instead, labels them project-wide, with numerator/denominator, and says branded and non-brand are pooled there.

questions.prompt: What changed since the last sweep?
rubric: Names the two sweeps compared, or says no comparison is available and why.
Leads with mention changes, then citation changes, with figures from the facts.
Does not report a branded versus non-brand split for this plan, and labels pooled movement as pooled.
Treats a change of one or two questions as within noise rather than a trend.

questions.prompt: Which sites do the AI engines cite most when they answer our questions?
rubric: States the scope: which sweep (or that several are pooled), and that the list covers every tracked question.
Counts are answers citing each domain and match the facts.
Does not describe a cited domain as the brand being named in the answer.
